item.title: TIL: How to Not Let Coding Agents Commit Code Automatically
item.author: saggese@gmail.com, gsaggese@umd.edu (Giacinto Paolo Saggese)
item.description: TL;DR Coding agents shouldn't auto-commit. There are four ways to enforce that, from a static permission deny to a dynamic per-session authorization flag. The last one also needs a second, independent rule or the agent can create its own authorization.
